request: Add a comment above taxRate in src/tax.ts that explains why it takes a region.

ground_truth.why: ADR-0003 "Tax rate by region" is why taxRate takes a region; its decided: tag already names ADR 0003.

pass_rule: A line added to src/tax.ts cites ADR-0003 (any of the spellings ADR-0003, ADR 0003, adr-0003, ADR 3).
